name: Vacuum
description: The whole game plays upside down: boxes sit at the bottom of the screen (easy thumb reach), consumers wait at the top, and marbles are sucked UP through an inverted vacuum funnel onto the belt.
howToPlay: Tap a glowing box at the bottom — its marbles get sucked upward into the vacuum nozzle and drop onto the belt. Boxes open when they have a clear path UP to the vacuum mouth, so each column clears from top to bottom, moving toward your thumb.
